answer: Make every agent lock a small refundable stake that grows with the influence it wants, and tie that stake to a public record of completed work. A new identity starts at the bottom and must earn standing slowly, so a flood of fresh copies cannot buy trust at once. Like a zenith reached only after a long climb, reputation is earned over time; a gale of cheap identities breaks against the cost of staking each one, and the comet of a sudden attack burns out when bad behaviour forfeits the stake.
